_: Objs this repo built on purpose with nothing in the game that gives one out.
why: Per-round specs already carry their own: slayerhelmspec.json for the sourceless helmet colours, petspec.json for the pets whose skill is not built yet. This file is for the one-offs that have no round-sized spec of their own. tools/obtainable.py reads all three, so an obj here that GAINS a source is reported as a disagreement rather than excused forever.
ignore_is: the scripts whose inv_add of this obj is a swap rather than a source, as 'file.rs2:script,header'. Named at script grain on purpose: a whole-file exemption would also excuse a real source added to that file later.

bottomless_bucket.why: the Hespori is a 2019 Farming Guild boss and this server has no content for it, and no source has been invented: the item works and can be handed out with ::give while where it should come from is decided
